idea-plugin.name: IC10
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for IC10, the Stationeers in-game scripting language.
Hover, completion, diagnostics and pseudocode inlay hints for .ic files, served by the IC10 language server.
The server is a standalone executable of about 116 MB and ships inside this plugin (it arrives compressed to roughly 40 MB, and a standalone server has to embed a JavaScript runtime). Settings | Tools | IC10 can point at a different executable if you have your own build.
